source_title: Wheelhouse Announces Acquisition of All Star Garage Door
source_excerpt:
BALDWIN PARK, Calif. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wheelhouse is proud to announce the acquisition of All Star Garage Door, a family-owned residential and commercial garage door company serving communities across California and Utah. The deal marks Wheelhouse's second acquisition of 2026.
Founded in 2008, All Star Garage Door has built its reputation on quality garage door installation, service and repair, reflected in its tagline, "The Face of Fine Homes." Today, the company has more than 30 employees. In addition to serving Southern California, the Central Valley and the Central Coast, All Star expanded into Utah in 2024, bringing its services to the St. George and Park City communities.
"Ryan Salinas and his team have built something special at All Star," said Ron Avidan, CEO of Wheelhouse. "Their craftsmanship and customer care align with our values, and we're thrilled to welcome them to our growing family of brands."
"Our success has always been driven by the dedication of our All Star employees, the trust of our customers, the support of our partners and the relationships we've built over the years," said Ryan Salinas, owner of All Star Garage Door. "I'm excited for All Star to begin this next chapter in partnership with Wheelhouse, which creates tremendous opportunities for continued growth and long-term success."
Wheelhouse is actively seeking add-on opportunities with owner-operated garage door businesses across the United States. To learn more about partnering with Wheelhouse, contact Lucas Lebrao, VP of Corporate Development, at [email protected] or visit www.wheelhouse-brands.com/contact.
About Wheelhouse Wheelhouse, backed by Trivest Partners, is a national growth platform built for the residential and commercial garage door service and installation industry. The company partners with established, founder-led businesses across the United States, providing the systems, leadership and infrastructure they need to grow. For more information, visit www.wheelhouse-brands.com .
